name: Kagura Ryouentan ~Saya no Shou~
source:
Shinonome Saya, a newly appointed exorcist shrine maiden at Sawashiro Shrine, had been handling requests to resolve supernatural disturbances alongside her younger sister, Shinonome Satsuki.
But one day, when Satsuki was away, a new exorcism request came in.
Saya didn’t have much experience working alone, but she thought, If I’m the only one available right now, then I’ve got to step up!
With that, she set out to investigate.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01001325.html/]dlsite[/url]]
